model_changes.change: Goalkeepers entered training for the first time.
model_changes.detail: The archive spelled goalkeeper GK and the rest of the system spelled it GKP, so 12,500 rows, 11% of the archive, had never reached training, and the is_gkp feature was a constant zero while 71 keepers a week were predicted anyway. Scores before GW6 come from a model that had never seen a goalkeeper, so they are not strictly comparable with those after it.
